Mali.title: Sahel: The number of displaced in Burkina Faso, Mali and Niger has almost doubled since 2020, according to UNHCR
Mali.summary: The United Nations High Commissioner for Refugees (UNHCR) warns of the displacement crisis in the Sahel: Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger now have nearly 4 million displaced persons and refugees, almost twice as many as in 2020, the year of the first military coup in Bamako . Published on: In Mali, Burkina Faso and Niger, “security incidents have nearly doubled since 2020, weakening the state presence […] and increasing risks for both displaced people and host communities,” said Abdouraouf Gnon-Konde, UNHCR's Director for West and Central Africa, on Friday, 9 October .

Niger.title: Zinder: eleven suspects arrested after the dismantling of two criminal networks
Niger.summary: Eleven individuals arrested, fifteen victims identified and three people actively wanted: the dismantling of two criminal networks by the Zinder Interregional Criminal Police Service reveals serial robberies in homes and markets, as well as a concealment circuit linking Zinder, Maradi and the surroundings of Takeita. The case started with an abandoned motorcycle in the Jacques Chirac district of Zinder .
